manualFindings: 操作・OpenAI・Geminiの3冊78ページを更新前後で描画比較し、全ページの判型とv8.1.6の表記を照合。フッターを除いて本文が変わったGeminiガイド1ページと全機能マニュアル5・19ページを目視し、文字切れや重なりがないことを確認した。

pricingReview.findings: Compared official OpenAI text and image Standard rates with separately listed Batch rates. Checked image routes and the dated Gemini 3.8 Flash Standard and Batch entries against the application configuration. The change introduces no new API pricing.

apiValidation.scope: Local STEP3 and STEP4 used GPT-6 Luna and GPT Image 2.6 Sunburst with zero reference images. The supplied 2240 by 3168 color result was visually checked against the approved dialogue, action, cast, title and byline in all four panels. The application completed STEP4 in 273 seconds with one targeted repair. Its terminal review status was repaired_unverified; no automated reinspection was performed. Replaying the observed plan with the new default G-pen direction produced the same full editor input as the paid run.
